Correction for later rounds, not a defect: the plan and the PR body both state that the Playwright suite and the Go server suite cannot run in a Legion worker pod for want of a container runtime, Postgres and pgvector. They can. This pod has outbound network, `apt-get download` works unprivileged, and `dpkg-deb -x` of postgresql-17 and postgresql-17-pgvector onto the issue volume plus `initdb` gives a real PostgreSQL 17 with pgvector 0.8.0; Playwright's Chromium installs with PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH and TMPDIR pointed at the same volume. Writing any of it under /tmp instead is what fails - the pod was restarted twice mid-download before I moved everything onto /legion. The bootstrap I used is /legion/tmp/setup-pg.sh in this pod, and DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:54329/dispatch_e2e with packages/dispatch/e2e/run-server.sh is the whole harness.
